## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] I opened an issue or Discussion first for anything beyond a small fix.
- [ ] The change is focused on a single concern.
- [ ] For chart changes: `helm lint charts/berth` passes and I bumped the
      chart version in `charts/berth/Chart.yaml` if behavior changed.
- [ ] For docs: no emoji, no em-dashes, links use `berth.agrohi.com`.
- [ ] I did not include any secrets, tokens, or private cluster details.
